name: How much does it cost to add a primary bedroom suite in San Diego County?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to add a primary bedroom suite in San Diego County?

acceptedAnswer.text:
There is no reliable single price without a measured design, but a primary suite generally costs more than a bedroom-only addition because it includes plumbing, waterproofing, fixtures, ventilation, tile, and additional electrical work. Construction guidance commonly places additions around $100–$300 per square foot nationally, but local conditions and finish choices can move a project outside that range.

A realistic budget should separate design and engineering, permits, demolition or site preparation, foundation, framing, roofing, windows, utilities, bathroom finishes, closets, and contingency. A rough square-foot calculation can miss expensive tie-ins and upgrades.

Key factors:
- Suite size and bathroom configuration
- Distance to existing sewer and water lines
- Foundation and grading requirements
- Cabinetry, tile, windows, and fixture selections

Practical guidance: Request a scope-based estimate with allowances and exclusions instead of comparing only a price per square foot. Keep a reserve for concealed conditions and owner-requested changes.

Elite Remodeling & Design can develop the design and construction scope needed for a more meaningful project estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: The price depends on size, foundation, bathroom plumbing, roof work, utilities, finishes, and site conditions. National addition guidance often cites roughly $100–$300 per square foot, but that is not a San Diego quote. Ask Elite Remodeling & Design for a scope-based estimate with allowances, exclusions, and a contingency.
